caption:
Angry today? Read this before you reply

Allah describes the righteous as those who spend in prosperity and adversity, restrain their anger and pardon people, and He tells us He loves those who do good. The next time anger rises, hold it and choose to pardon.

Surah Aal-i-Imraan 3:133-134

Pick one person to pardon before the day ends

#anger #pardonpeople #muslimcharacter #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
alt_text: And hasten towards forgiveness from your Lord and a Paradise as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for the righteous; those who spend in times of prosperity and adversity, and who restrain their anger and pardon people; for Allah loves those who do good (Surah Aal-i-Imraan 3:133-134)
